sentences.text: The three that are not are 2022, 2023 and 2024.
In 2022 he came down on the fourth of November and the first lying snow on the plateau was on the nineteenth.
In 2023 he came down on the ninth of November and the snow came on the twenty-eighth.
In 2024 he came down on the second and the snow came on the sixth of December, which is thirty-four days, which is not a margin of error.
Morag's mother wrote all three of those in the notebook without any note attached.
She has never underlined anything in that book and she did not start.

Morag was eleven in 2024 and she was in the enclosure with her mother on the afternoon he came down and she said, before she thought about it, "He's wrong again." Her mother did not answer for a while and then said: "He's not wrong." Morag said that thirty-four days was wrong.

And her mother — who is not a sentimental person and who has spent twenty-one years putting food out for animals in horizontal rain and has views about people who anthropomorphise them — said: "He came down when the tops stopped being worth staying on.
That is the only thing he has ever done.

He has never once been telling us about the weather." Morag remembers exactly where they were standing and that it was raining and that her mother said it without any heat at all, in the voice she uses for saying that a gate is broken.
Morag said that if that was true then the eighteen years were a coincidence.

She said that the tops stopping being worth staying on and the first snow used to be the same event, and that they are not the same event any more, and that this is the whole of it and there is nothing else in it.
